mechanism: Naproxen (NSAID) increases bleeding risk and may reduce renal perfusion, while nalmefene (opioid antagonist) can mask opioid-related adverse effects and complicate pain management in patients on concurrent NSAIDs.
action: Monitor for signs of GI bleeding and renal function; use lowest effective NSAID dose with gastroprotection; consider alternative analgesics if opioids are being antagonized.
